speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: This is not a diagnosis; I have not yet completed the clinical assessment. Based on your age, occupation on a rice farm with livestock, and symptoms of a pruritic rash on the upper body/face combined with palmar numbness/tingling, I suspect a parasitic infection such as *Cercarial Dermatitis* (Swimmer's Itch) or *Cutaneous Leishmaniasis*, potentially with associated nerve involvement.
